note: Set A's claims are all supported and correctly bound, covering the cooking thresholds, the 96.00 oz (2.721 kg) starting-water requirement, dinner party count, and neighborhood structure, though it repeats several claims verbatim in different unit forms. Set B adds useful facts A misses (appliance must run in normal configuration, guest list composition, 11 p.m. deadline) but omits the starting water weight requirement entirely and contains two false claims: 0 points for vaporized weight < 80 oz (contradicted by the reduced-points band) and 0 points for mass < 16 oz supported only by axis labels. Several of B's quotes are also stitched or paraphrased rather than verbatim (e.g. 'and 5.000 lb vaporized', '0% (lowest) to 100%'). A's redundancy is trivial but harmless, while B's errors misstate the scoring function, so A is better.
